W: High walls. Once, a whole regiment drilled in here.
B: A drill banner, stitched with a formation: three shields, side by side, in a row.
G: A portcullis. Three plates in the floor, and three sets of chains running from them up to the gate.
P: A pressure plate, worn smooth by boots. It won't stay down on its own.
O: A heavy boulder. You could push it, if you leaned in.
d: A straw drill dummy, stabbed a thousand times. It has a face drawn on. It looks tired.
H: A ladder, hidden behind the dummies, going down into the dark.
E: The way back to the hall.
